issue.title: Fix the README install command 🚀
issue.body:
## Summary
The README installs the upstream module.

## What to do
- Change the install line in `README.md` to `go get acme.dev/widget`.
- Remove the `widgetc` CLI section.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] README must not contain `widgetc`
- [ ] README must contain `go get acme.dev/widget`
- [ ] Every link in the README returns 200

Points: 75 (reputation, not money)

prs.author: ana
prs.title: Correct the install guide
prs.body: Fixes #1. Removes the widgetc section and fixes go get.

files.patch:
@@ -1,9 +1,2 @@
-go get upstream.dev/widget
+go get acme.dev/widget
-## widgetc
-go install upstream.dev/widget/cmd/widgetc
